*attribute* · *module attribute*

Repeat the option to export multiple splits.'), preprocess: bool = typer.Option(False, '--preprocess/--no-preprocess', help='Run the compiled pipeline until the requested preprocessing keys exist.'), preprocess_until_key: list[str] | None = typer.Option(None, '--preprocess-until-key', help='TensorDict x key marking the preprocessing boundary. Repeatable.'), x_key: list[str] | None = typer.Option(None, '--x-key', help='x TensorDict keys to persist. Repeatable. Default: all.'), y_key: list[str] | None = typer.Option(None, '--y-key', help='label TensorDict keys to persist. Repeatable. Default: all.'), include_labels: bool = typer.Option(True, '--labels/--no-labels', help='Include labels from the batch y TensorDict.'), dtype: str | None = typer.Option(None, '--dtype', help='Optional storage dtype passed to the export backend, e.g. float16.'), samples_per_shard: int = typer.Option(256, '--samples-per-shard', help='Samples per WebDataset tar shard'), s3_endpoint_url: str | None = typer.Option(None, '--s3-endpoint-url', help='Optional S3-compatible endpoint'), s3_region: str | None = typer.Option(None, '--s3-region', help='Optional S3 region'), s3_profile: str | None = typer.Option(None, '--s3-profile', help='Optional AWS credential profile name'))

## nexuml.cli.overrides.apply_overrides

*function*

```python
def apply_overrides(scenario: Any, overrides: list[str]) -> Any
```

Apply ``key.path=value`` overrides to a ScenarioSpec in-place.

Dot-separated paths traverse Pydantic model attributes and dict keys.
Values are coerced to int/float/bool/list before assignment.
Prints a Rich table summarising each change.

**Returns**

- (`Any`) — The mutated *scenario* instance.

**Raises**

- `ValueError` — If an override string is malformed or has an empty path segment.
- `KeyError` — If a path segment does not exist on the scenario.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/cli/overrides.py#L40-L98)

## nexuml.core.PostTrainFitLayer

*class*

```python
class PostTrainFitLayer(PipelineLayer)
```

Bases: `nexuml.core.base_layer.PipelineLayer`

Re-exported from: `nexuml.core.post_train_layer`

Abstract pipeline layer that requires a post-training fit pass.

Lifecycle (managed by NexuSession._fit_post_train_layers):
  1. Orchestrator arms exactly one unfitted layer per predict pass: ``layer._armed = True``
  2. During that predict pass, ``forward()`` calls ``collect_batch(x, y)`` and returns
     ``(x, y)`` unchanged (no output key written yet).
  3. ``on_predict_end()`` calls ``finalize_fit()`` and sets ``_fitted = True``.
  4. On subsequent calls, ``forward()`` calls ``_transform_forward(x, y)`` (fitted mode).
  5. Other unfitted layers in the same pass are not armed — they pass through silently.

Fitted state is persisted via Lightning checkpoint hooks so loading a checkpoint
restores a fully fitted pipeline without re-running fit passes.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/post_train_layer.py#L17-L98)

# nexuml.core.base_layer

## nexuml.core.base_layer.PipelineLayer

*class*

```python
class PipelineLayer(torch.nn.Module)
```

Bases: `torch.nn.Module`

Base class for all NexuML pipeline layers.

Subclasses implement ``forward_tensor`` and optionally override lifecycle
hooks (``on_fit_start``, ``on_fit_end``).  The base ``forward`` method
routes each ``keys_in`` key through ``forward_tensor`` and writes results
to the corresponding ``keys_out`` key in the output ``TensorDict``.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/base_layer.py#L29-L183)

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/compiler.py#L1-L1)

## nexuml.core.compiler.logger

*attribute* · *module attribute*

```python
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
```

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/compiler.py#L18-L18)

## nexuml.core.compiler.compile

*function*

```python
def compile(scenario: ScenarioSpec) -> CompiledPipeline
```

Compile a ScenarioSpec into a runnable CompiledPipeline.

> **Steps**
>
> 1. Iterate pipeline stages in order
> 2. For each LayerSpec: resolve meta_in, materialize its definition, capture meta_out
> 3. Run dummy forward for shape propagation
> 4. Return assembled CompiledPipeline

**Returns**

- (`CompiledPipeline`) — Compiled pipeline ready for training or inference.

**Raises**

- `TypeError` — If a definition does not build a ``PipelineLayer``.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/compiler.py#L21-L130)

# nexuml.core.discovery

*module*

Core discovery module with decorator-based registration and scanning.

Provides decorators (@layer, @data_source, @scenario, @eval_algorithm) that attach
metadata to objects, and a Scanner that collects decorated objects from imported
modules. Supports entry-point and local-root discovery.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/discovery.py#L1-L1)

## nexuml.core.discovery.DiscoveryError

*class*

```python
class DiscoveryError
```

A failure encountered while importing or registering a discovery item.

Collected instead of raised so that one broken module cannot hide every
other scenario/layer/dataset/eval algorithm in the registry.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/discovery.py#L66-L101)


Scan a single already-imported module for decorated objects.

**Returns**

- (`list[DiscoveredItem]`) — Newly discovered items found in *module*.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/discovery.py#L269-L291)

### nexuml.core.discovery.Scanner.scan_package

*method*

```python
def scan_package(package_path: str) -> list[DiscoveredItem]
```

Import a package (if possible) and recursively scan its modules.

Resilient by design: a module that fails to import (SyntaxError,
NameError, validation errors at import time, etc.) is recorded as a
:class:`DiscoveryError` and skipped, so the remaining modules in the
package are still discovered. Inspect :attr:`errors` afterwards to see
what was skipped and why.

**Returns**

- (`list[DiscoveredItem]`) — Newly discovered items across all modules in the package.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/discovery.py#L293-L332)

### nexuml.core.discovery.Scanner.scan_packages

*method*

```python
def scan_packages(package_paths: list[str]) -> list[DiscoveredItem]
```

Scan multiple package paths.

**Returns**

- (`list[DiscoveredItem]`) — Combined list of discovered items from all packages.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/discovery.py#L334-L343)

## nexuml.core.discovery.register_items

*function*

```python
def register_items(items: list[DiscoveredItem], register: Callable[[str, Any], None], errors: list[DiscoveryError]) -> None
```

Register each discovered item, collecting (not raising) failures.

Mirrors the resilience of :meth:`Scanner.scan_package`: a single key
conflict or bad item must not wipe out every other item in the registry.
Appends a :class:`DiscoveryError` (phase="register") for each failure.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/discovery.py#L507-L538)

## nexuml.core.discovery.scan_all

*function*

```python
def scan_all(extra_package_paths: list[str] | None = None, include_entry_points: bool = True, include_local_roots: bool = True) -> Scanner
```

Scan built-in packages, entry points, and local roots for decorated items.

No persistent object cache is used; this always performs fresh imports.

**Returns**

- (`Scanner`) — Scanner populated with all discovered items.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/discovery.py#L541-L562)

## nexuml.core.discovery.scenario

*function*

```python
def scenario(key: str) -> Callable[[Any], Any]
```

Decorator to register a scenario function.

**Returns**

- (`Callable[[Any], Any]`) — Decorator that attaches discovery metadata to *fn*.


## nexuml.core.export.export_package

*function*

```python
def export_package(pipeline: CompiledPipeline, path: Path, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None, lightning_module: Any | None = None, trainer: Any | None = None, checkpoint_path: str | Path | None = None, include_modules: list[str] | None = None, source_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Path
```

Export a trained pipeline as a rich package-backed artifact directory.

**Parameters**

- `pipeline` (`CompiledPipeline`) — Compiled pipeline to export.
- `path` (`Path`) — Destination directory.
- `metadata` (`dict[str, Any] | None`) (default: `None`) — Optional provenance metadata merged into the artifact.
- `lightning_module` (`Any | None`) (default: `None`) — Optional Lightning module for checkpoint sidecars.
- `trainer` (`Any | None`) (default: `None`) — Optional Lightning trainer for training-state sidecars.
- `checkpoint_path` (`str | Path | None`) (default: `None`) — Optional source Lightning checkpoint to preserve.
- `include_modules` (`list[str] | None`) (default: `None`) — Optional glob patterns for additional source modules to intern (useful for dynamic imports invisible to torch.package).
- `source_metadata` (`dict[str, Any] | None`) (default: `None`) — Optional metadata describing the export source (e.g. CLI checkpoint path). Merged into *metadata*.

**Returns**

- (`Path`) — Path to the created export directory.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/export.py#L501-L623)

## nexuml.core.export.export_safetensors

*function*

```python
def export_safetensors(pipeline: CompiledPipeline, path: Path, include: list[str] | None = None, exclude: list[str] | None = None, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Path
```

Export pipeline weights as SafeTensors plus a JSON manifest.

**Returns**

- (`Path`) — Path to the created ``.safetensors`` file.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/export.py#L917-L947)

## nexuml.core.pipeline.CompiledPipeline

*class*

```python
class CompiledPipeline(nn.Module)
```

Bases: `nn.Module`

Executable pipeline assembled from compiled layer specs.

Holds ordered stages of layers, executes sequentially over TensorDicts,
and provides optimizer/scheduler factory methods.

### nexuml.core.pipeline.CompiledPipeline.call_layer_hook

*method*

### nexuml.core.pipeline.CompiledPipeline.forward_until

*method*

```python
def forward_until(x: TensorDict, y: TensorDict | None = None, *, x_keys: Sequence[str] | None = None, y_keys: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> tuple[TensorDict, TensorDict | None]
```

Run the pipeline until the requested keys are available.

This is useful for feature export when the codebase does not yet model
preprocessing layers separately from the rest of the network.

**Returns**

- (`tuple[TensorDict, TensorDict | None]`) — Tuple of ``(x_out, y_out)`` with the requested keys present.

**Raises**

- `KeyError` — If the pipeline did not produce the requested keys.

# nexuml.core.post_train_layer

*module*

PostTrainFitLayer — pipeline layer with a post-training accumulate/fit lifecycle.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/post_train_layer.py#L1-L1)

## nexuml.core.post_train_layer.PostTrainFitLayer

*class*

```python
class PostTrainFitLayer(PipelineLayer)
```

Bases: `nexuml.core.base_layer.PipelineLayer`

Abstract pipeline layer that requires a post-training fit pass.

Lifecycle (managed by NexuSession._fit_post_train_layers):
  1. Orchestrator arms exactly one unfitted layer per predict pass: ``layer._armed = True``
  2. During that predict pass, ``forward()`` calls ``collect_batch(x, y)`` and returns
     ``(x, y)`` unchanged (no output key written yet).
  3. ``on_predict_end()`` calls ``finalize_fit()`` and sets ``_fitted = True``.
  4. On subsequent calls, ``forward()`` calls ``_transform_forward(x, y)`` (fitted mode).
  5. Other unfitted layers in the same pass are not armed — they pass through silently.

Fitted state is persisted via Lightning checkpoint hooks so loading a checkpoint
restores a fully fitted pipeline without re-running fit passes.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/post_train_layer.py#L17-L98)

## nexuml.core.scenario_loader.load_scenario_file

*function*

```python
def load_scenario_file(path: str | Path) -> LoadedScenarioFile
```

Load a trusted Python file exposing ``scenario() -> ScenarioSpec``.

**Returns**

- (`LoadedScenarioFile`) — Loaded scenario file with metadata, search space, and tuning spec.

**Raises**

- `FileNotFoundError` — If *path* does not exist.
- `ValueError` — If the file is not a ``.py`` file or lacks a callable ``scenario()``.
- `TypeError` — If ``scenario()`` does not return a ``ScenarioSpec``.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/scenario_loader.py#L166-L205)

## nexuml.core.types.AxisKeySpec

*class* · *pydantic model*

```python
class AxisKeySpec(BaseModel)
```

Bases: `BaseModel`

Typed axis-key declaration with source provenance.

``source`` indicates where the axis value is resolved from at runtime:

- ``"x"``: from the transformed pipeline output TensorDict (e.g. a
  reconstructed feature or anomaly score produced by a pipeline layer).
- ``"y"``: from the label TensorDict — most common for grouping axes such
  as ``machine``, ``section``, or ``target``.
- ``"metadata"``: from the dataset metadata DataFrame attached to the batch
  by ``_attach_eval_metadata``.  Use this source for non-tensor columns that
  are not part of the label TensorDict but are needed for grouped evaluation
  (e.g. ``basename``, ``domain``).  Only available during eval/test phases.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/types.py#L24-L40)

```python
key: str
```

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/types.py#L39-L39)

### nexuml.core.types.AxisKeySpec.source

*attribute* · *pydantic field*

```python
source: Literal['x', 'y', 'metadata'] = 'y'
```

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/types.py#L40-L40)

### nexuml.core.types.SchedulerSpec.resolve_warmup

*method*

```python
def resolve_warmup(max_epochs: int) -> int
```

Resolve the warmup spec to an integer number of epochs.

Accepts an integer (used directly), a percentage string like ``"5%"``
(computed as a fraction of *max_epochs*), or ``None`` (returns 0).
The result is always at least 1 when a non-zero warmup is specified.

**Returns**

- (`int`) — Resolved warmup epoch count.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/core/types.py#L168-L186)

## nexuml.data.NexuDataModule

*class*

```python
class NexuDataModule(L.LightningDataModule)
```

Bases: `L.LightningDataModule`

Re-exported from: `nexuml.data.module`

Lightning DataModule wrapping a ``NexuDataset``.

Supports:
- random splits or metadata-driven splits
- weighted sampling for the native torch backend
- backend-driven loader construction via ``LoaderSpec.backend``

## nexuml.data.NexuDataset

*class*

```python
class NexuDataset(torch.utils.data.Dataset)
```

Bases: `torch.utils.data.Dataset`

Re-exported from: `nexuml.data.dataset`

Base dataset returning ``(x, y)`` TensorDict pairs.

The base class supports two common patterns used throughout NexuML:

- metadata-backed datasets via ``self.meta``
- in-memory datasets via ``self.data``

Subclasses can still override ``__getitem__`` entirely for bespoke behavior.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/data/dataset.py#L34-L278)

## nexuml.data.auto_batch.generate_candidates

*function*

```python
def generate_candidates(config: AutoBatchSizeSpec) -> list[int]
```

Generate bounded power-of-two candidates in ascending order.

**Returns**

- (`list[int]`) — Sorted list of candidate batch sizes.

**Raises**

- `ValueError` — If the candidate strategy is not ``power_of_two``.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/data/auto_batch.py#L49-L69)

## nexuml.data.auto_batch.is_cuda_oom

```python
def is_cuda_oom(exc: BaseException) -> bool
```

Return True if the exception is a CUDA out-of-memory error.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/data/auto_batch.py#L94-L97)

## nexuml.data.auto_batch.resolve_with_probe

*function*

```python
def resolve_with_probe(config: AutoBatchSizeSpec, probe: Callable[[int], None]) -> BatchProbeResult
```

Try candidate batch sizes and return selected size plus observable metadata.

**Returns**

- (`BatchProbeResult`) — Aggregated probe result with selected batch size.

**Raises**

- `RuntimeError` — If no candidate succeeds because candidates hit CUDA OOM or exceed
the configured margin policy.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/data/auto_batch.py#L127-L202)

```python
def select_batch_size(successes: list[int], config: AutoBatchSizeSpec) -> int
```

**Returns**

- (`int`) — The selected batch size.

**Raises**

- `ValueError` — If ``successes`` is empty or the safety policy is unsupported.

## nexuml.data.dataset.NexuDataset

*class*

```python
class NexuDataset(torch.utils.data.Dataset)
```

Bases: `torch.utils.data.Dataset`

Base dataset returning ``(x, y)`` TensorDict pairs.

The base class supports two common patterns used throughout NexuML:

- metadata-backed datasets via ``self.meta``
- in-memory datasets via ``self.data``

Subclasses can still override ``__getitem__`` entirely for bespoke behavior.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/data/dataset.py#L34-L278)

## nexuml.data.export.ExportBackend

*class*

```python
class ExportBackend(ABC)
```

Bases: `ABC`

Re-exported from: `nexuml.data.export.backend`

Abstract base class for dataset export backends.

Each backend handles serialization of feature tensors to a specific
storage format. The metadata (labels, splits, source info) is always
stored as parquet alongside the backend-specific data directory.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/data/export/backend.py#L40-L89)

## nexuml.data.export.NumpyMmapBackend

*class*

```python
class NumpyMmapBackend(ExportBackend)
```

Bases: `nexuml.data.export.backend.ExportBackend`

Re-exported from: `nexuml.data.export.numpy_mmap`

Memory-mapped NumPy backend for large-scale datasets.

Pre-allocates a single `.npy` file per feature key with shape
`(num_samples, *feature_shape)` for efficient sequential writes and
memory-mapped reads. Requires all samples to have uniform feature shapes.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/data/export/numpy_mmap.py#L17-L170)

## nexuml.data.export.TensorShardsBackend

*class*

```python
class TensorShardsBackend(ExportBackend)
```

Bases: `nexuml.data.export.backend.ExportBackend`

Re-exported from: `nexuml.data.export.tensor_shards`

Write arbitrary fixed-shape tensor keys into sample shards.

A shard is a storage unit with ``N`` samples along dimension zero. It is
NOT a training batch; the runtime loader may create arbitrary batch sizes
from the shard contents.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/data/export/tensor_shards.py#L52-L520)

## nexuml.data.export.backend.ExportBackend

*class*

```python
class ExportBackend(ABC)
```

Bases: `ABC`

Abstract base class for dataset export backends.

Each backend handles serialization of feature tensors to a specific
storage format. The metadata (labels, splits, source info) is always
stored as parquet alongside the backend-specific data directory.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/data/export/backend.py#L40-L89)

## nexuml.data.export.backend.ExportConfig

*class* · *dataclass*

```python
class ExportConfig
```

## nexuml.data.export.numpy_mmap.NumpyMmapBackend

*class*

```python
class NumpyMmapBackend(ExportBackend)
```

Bases: `nexuml.data.export.backend.ExportBackend`

Memory-mapped NumPy backend for large-scale datasets.

Pre-allocates a single `.npy` file per feature key with shape
`(num_samples, *feature_shape)` for efficient sequential writes and
memory-mapped reads. Requires all samples to have uniform feature shapes.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/data/export/numpy_mmap.py#L17-L170)

# nexuml.data.export.tensor_shards

*module*

Non-prebatched tensor-shard export backend.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/data/export/tensor_shards.py#L1-L1)

## nexuml.data.export.tensor_shards.TensorShardsBackend

*class*

```python
class TensorShardsBackend(ExportBackend)
```

Bases: `nexuml.data.export.backend.ExportBackend`

Write arbitrary fixed-shape tensor keys into sample shards.

A shard is a storage unit with ``N`` samples along dimension zero. It is
NOT a training batch; the runtime loader may create arbitrary batch sizes
from the shard contents.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/data/export/tensor_shards.py#L52-L520)

## nexuml.data.super_dataset.SuperDataset

*class*

```python
class SuperDataset(NexuDataset)
```

Bases: `nexuml.data.dataset.NexuDataset`

Merges multiple datasets (keyed by name) into one dataset.

Adds a "dataset" column to the merged DataFrame to track origin.
Supports label merging and dataset subdivision for federated/multi-client scenarios.

# nexuml.evaluation

*module*

Evaluation module for NexuML.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/evaluation/__init__.py#L1-L1)

## nexuml.evaluation.EvalAlgorithm

*class*

```python
class EvalAlgorithm(ABC)
```

Bases: `ABC`

Re-exported from: `nexuml.evaluation.algorithm`

Base class for post-training evaluation algorithms.

> **Flat batch lifecycle**
>
> - fit_batch(x, y) — accumulate statistics from one train batch (optional)
> - fit_end() — finalize fitting after all train batches
> - eval_batch(x, y) — process one test batch using fitted state
> - eval_end() — finalize evaluation after all test batches
> - results() — return computed metrics as a flat dict

Evaluation algorithms are consumer-only: they read from the pipeline output
TensorDict and never produce new score keys. Score-producing components
belong in the pipeline as PostTrainFitLayer subclasses.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/evaluation/algorithm.py#L127-L159)

Bases: `KeyError`

## nexuml.evaluation.algorithm.DistanceEstimator

*class*

```python
class DistanceEstimator(ABC)
```

Bases: `ABC`

Abstract base for streaming distance estimators.

> **Lifecycle**
>
> 1. fit_batch(features, labels=None) — accumulate train statistics batch-by-batch
> 2. fit_end() — finalize (compute inverse covariance, fit GMM, etc.)
> 3. score(features, labels=None) — return per-sample anomaly scores

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/evaluation/algorithm.py#L162-L181)

## nexuml.evaluation.algorithm.get_declared_axis

*function*

```python
def get_declared_axis(x: TensorDict, y: TensorDict | None, axis_spec: Any, *, metadata: Any = None, algorithm: str = '') -> Any
```

Resolve a declared axis key from x, y, or metadata per its provenance.

Enforces EXACT provenance — no silent fallback between sources.
axis_spec may be a string (shorthand, defaults source=y) or an AxisKeySpec.
``metadata`` is an optional DataFrame-like with per-sample columns.

**Returns**

- (`Any`) — The resolved axis value from the appropriate source.

**Raises**

- `ValueError` — If *axis_spec* references an unknown source.
- `ContractError` — If the declared key is missing from the resolved source.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/evaluation/algorithm.py#L36-L92)

## nexuml.evaluation.algorithm.get_declared_tensor

*function*

```python
def get_declared_tensor(x: TensorDict, key: str, *, algorithm: str = '') -> Any
```

Return a declared tensor key from x; raise ContractError if absent.

``algorithm`` is included in diagnostics when provided.

**Returns**

- (`Any`) — The tensor stored under *key*.

**Raises**

- `ContractError` — If *key* is not present in *x*.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/evaluation/algorithm.py#L16-L33)

## nexuml.evaluation.algorithm.get_fit_mask

*function*

```python
def get_fit_mask(x: TensorDict, y: TensorDict | None, fit_mask_key: str | None, batch_size: int, *, algorithm: str = '') -> torch.Tensor
```

Resolve fit mask to a bool tensor; returns all-True if fit_mask_key is None.

**Returns**

- (`torch.Tensor`) — Bool tensor of shape ``(batch_size,)``.

**Raises**

- `ContractError` — If *fit_mask_key* is not found in *y* or *x*.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/evaluation/algorithm.py#L95-L124)

## nexuml.evaluation.utils.MemmapFeatureStore

*class*

```python
class MemmapFeatureStore(FeatureStore)
```

Bases: `nexuml.evaluation.utils.FeatureStore`

Disk-backed feature storage that streams directly to a numpy memmap.

Features are written to disk during ``append()`` without buffering in RAM.
The memmap is pre-allocated to ``(max_samples, D)`` when ``max_samples`` is
provided; otherwise capacity starts at 1024 rows and doubles as needed.
``finalize()`` trims the file to the actual row count written.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/evaluation/utils.py#L109-L199)

### nexuml.evaluation.utils.MemmapFeatureStore.filename

*attribute* · *instance attribute*

```python
filename = self.storage_path / features-{uuid.uuid4().hex}.dat
```

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/evaluation/utils.py#L134-L134)

## nexuml.evaluation.utils.ReservoirSampler

*class*

```python
class ReservoirSampler
```

Online reservoir sampling (Vitter's Algorithm R).

Maintains a fixed-size random sample of items seen so far,
suitable for streaming large datasets without storing everything.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/evaluation/utils.py#L16-L52)

# nexuml.execution.kubernetes

*module*

## nexuml.execution.kubernetes.cancel

*function*

```python
def cancel(reference: NativeReference) -> dict
```

Delete only a UID-verified owned workload and confirm foreground termination.

**Returns**

- (`dict`) — A confirmed cancellation or an explicit unknown/error state.

**Raises**

- `ExecutionError` — If cancellation cannot stop the native workload safely.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/execution/kubernetes.py#L572-L595)


[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/tracking/logger.py#L21-L21)

## nexuml.tracking.logger.create_loggers

*function*

```python
def create_loggers(logging_spec: 'LoggingSpec | None', run_name: str | None = None) -> list[Any]
```

Build a list of Lightning loggers from a LoggingSpec.

Returns an empty list (disables logging) if spec is None.
Each backend is imported lazily so missing optional deps don't crash the import.

**Parameters**

- `logging_spec` (`'LoggingSpec | None'`) — LoggingSpec instance or None.
- `run_name` (`str | None`) (default: `None`) — Override run name; falls back to logging_spec.run_name.

**Returns**

- (`list[Any]`) — List of Lightning logger instances ready for Trainer(logger=...).

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/tracking/logger.py#L238-L296)

## nexuml.tracking.logger.log_artifact

*function*

```python
def log_artifact(logger_obj: Any, source_path: str | Path, artifact_path: str | None = None) -> None
```

Log or copy a file artifact to all configured logger backends.

**Raises**

- `FileNotFoundError` — If *source_path* does not exist.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/tracking/logger.py#L440-L477)

## nexuml.tracking.logger.log_image

*function*

```python
def log_image(logger_obj: Any, tag: str, image: Any, step: int | None = None, artifact_path: str | None = None) -> None
```

Log an image to all configured logger backends.

**Parameters**

- `logger_obj` (`Any`) — Lightning logger or list of loggers.
- `tag` (`str`) — Name/tag for the image (e.g. ``"val/reconstruction"``). Slashes are used as subdirectory separators for file-based backends.
- `image` (`Any`) — Image data — numpy array (HWC, uint8 or float [0,1]), PIL Image, or torch tensor (CHW, uint8 or float [0,1]).
- `step` (`int | None`) (default: `None`) — Global step for time-series backends (TensorBoard).
- `artifact_path` (`str | None`) (default: `None`) — Optional subdirectory within the run's artifact store (MLflow / file-based backends only).

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/tracking/logger.py#L519-L580)

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/tracking/logger.py#L480-L490)


Print actionable commands for all active monitoring services.

Called once at the start of training so the user knows how to
inspect metrics, tune hyperparameters, etc.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/tracking/logger.py#L706-L821)

### nexuml.training.NexuSession.predict

*method*

```python
def predict(dataloaders: Any = None, datamodule: NexuDataModule | None = None, return_predictions: bool = False) -> Any
```

Run Trainer.predict() with session defaults unless explicitly overridden.

**Returns**

- (`Any`) — Prediction outputs from ``Trainer.predict()``, or ``None`` when
- (`Any`) — *return_predictions* is ``False``.

# nexuml.tuning.optuna_tuner

*module*

Optuna-based hyperparameter tuning for NexuML.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/tuning/optuna_tuner.py#L1-L1)



[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/tuning/optuna_tuner.py#L13-L13)

## nexuml.tuning.optuna_tuner.build_objective

*function*

```python
def build_objective(base_scenario: ScenarioSpec, search_space: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], metric_key: str = 'val/loss', enable_progress_bar: bool = False, build_factory: Callable[..., ScenarioSpec] | None = None) -> Callable
```

Build an Optuna objective function from a base scenario and search space.

**Parameters**

- `base_scenario` (`ScenarioSpec`) — The base ScenarioSpec to tune.
- `search_space` (`dict[str, dict[str, Any]]`) — Dict mapping dotted-path param names to Optuna suggest kwargs. Each entry must have a "type" key (float, int, categorical) and the remaining keys are forwarded to the Optuna suggest method. Example::     {         "training.lr": {"type": "float", "low": 1e-5, "high": 1e-2, "log": True},         "training.max_epochs": {"type": "int", "low": 5, "high": 50},         "training.batch_size": {"type": "categorical", "choices": [32, 64, 128]},     }
- `metric_key` (`str`) (default: `'val/loss'`) — Lightning logged metric to optimise (must be logged with self.log()).
- `enable_progress_bar` (`bool`) (default: `False`) — Show Lightning progress bar during each trial.
- `build_factory` (`Callable[..., ScenarioSpec] | None`) (default: `None`) — Optional factory to rebuild the scenario from sampled params.

**Returns**

- `Callable` (`Callable`) — objective(trial) -> float | list[float]

**Raises**

- `ImportError` — If the ``optuna`` package is not installed.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/tuning/optuna_tuner.py#L41-L112)

## nexuml.tuning.optuna_tuner.tune

*function*

```python
def tune(scenario: ScenarioSpec, search_space: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], tuning_spec: TuningSpec | None = None, metric_key: str = 'val/loss', enable_progress_bar: bool = False, build_factory: Callable[..., ScenarioSpec] | None = None) -> Any
```

Run Optuna hyperparameter search.

**Parameters**

- `scenario` (`ScenarioSpec`) — Base ScenarioSpec to tune.
- `search_space` (`dict[str, dict[str, Any]]`) — Dict mapping dotted-path param names to Optuna suggest kwargs.
- `tuning_spec` (`TuningSpec | None`) (default: `None`) — TuningSpec controlling n_trials, storage, pruning, etc.
- `metric_key` (`str`) (default: `'val/loss'`) — Logged metric to optimise.
- `enable_progress_bar` (`bool`) (default: `False`) — Show progress bar during each trial.
- `build_factory` (`Callable[..., ScenarioSpec] | None`) (default: `None`) — Optional factory to rebuild the scenario from sampled params.

**Returns**

- (`Any`) — Completed ``optuna.Study``.

**Raises**

- `ImportError` — If the ``optuna`` package is not installed.

[View source](https://github.com/NexuFed/NexuML/blob/0ac41f9fdf4b1f0bdb4182261c550f9fa6b08dba/src/nexuml/tuning/optuna_tuner.py#L233-L325)
